newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Victoria Docklands Authority names preferred bids.
newsitem.headline: Victoria Docklands Authority names preferred bids.

text.p: The authority in charge of the Melbourne Docklands sports and entertainment stadium project said on Monday it had chosen two consortiums as preferred bidders on the project.

The Docklands Authority, which will choose the winner, said favoured bidders were Docklands Stadium Consortium, comprising construction group, Baulderstone Hornibrook and accountancy firm, KPMG, and the Melbourne Sports Stadium Consortium, partnered by private construction firms, Transfield and Grocon.
A third tenderer on the project, Lend Lease Corp Ltd, was not chosen as a preferred bidder.
The consortium also includes Lend Lease and Mirvac Ltd.
The Docklands Authority said it also intended to recommend to the Victorian goverment two preferred bidders for each of the five precincts by the end of August.
